buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder must submit the attested scanned copy of following documents: (a) Valid Authorization Certificate issued by the OEM authorizing the bidder to quote, supply, install, co mmission and provide after-sales service for the offered Industrial Vacuum Cleaner (Flameproof). (b) Duly filled and signed Technical Compliance Chart against each specification of Annexure-A, clearl y mentioning the offered value/specification and corresponding reference to the OEM catalogue/da tasheet. (c) Valid hazardous-area/flameproof certification or equivalent documentary evidence issued by a com petent statutory/recognized independent third-party certification body, wherever applicable, for th e exact make, model and configuration offered, clearly establishing suitability for Gas Group IIA & I IB, Zone-1 & Zone-2 and the intended flammable vapour atmosphere/operating conditions. The do cument shall indicate the applicable hazardous-area protection, gas/vapour group, temperature cl ass and other relevant safety parameters, wherever applicable, and shall be valid/traceable on the date of bid submission. (d) Valid certificate/document for the flameproof motor and FLP starter/control equipment actually off ered with the equipment, clearly identifying the make/model/rating and applicable hazardous-area protection/classification. (e) OEM documentation/undertaking confirming that the offered suction hose and accessories are suita ble for anti-static/static-dissipative operation. (f) Warranty Undertaking confirming minimum 02 years comprehensive onsite warranty from successf ul installation, testing and commissioning, including replacement of defective parts, labour, transp ortation and service charges as stipulated in the ATC. (g) Additional Terms & Conditions, duly sealed and signed as proof of acceptance.

(h) A self declaration as per annexure B that the firm is not black listed for Government transaction by any department/PSU of Government of India. (i) Documentary proof in the form of Supply Orders and Installation/Completion Certificates regarding successful supply, installation and commissioning of at least one similar Industrial Vacuum Cleaner during the last three financial years preceding the date of submission of bid. (j) An undertaking from the OEM/bidder that the offered equipment shall be brand new, unused, of lat est manufacture, free from manufacturing defects and complete with all standard accessories, and that no refurbished or obsolete equipment shall be supplied. . 3.
